item.title: Oh My Opencode in Practice: When Orchestration Pays and When It Bills
item.description: Oh My Opencode promises a virtual AI dev team — Sisyphus orchestrating specialists in parallel behind one ultrawork keyword. The promise holds for the right workload and taxes everything else: tripled tokens on single-window tasks, five-figure startup context, and at least one incident where a looping subagent billed hundreds unsupervised. Hands-on results plus community data below.
